$comment: Terminology + register policy for Lisse website translations. Translators (human or AI) MUST follow this for every locale. Tokens that must appear verbatim in EVERY locale are enforced by i18n/do-not-translate.json + scripts/validate-translations.ts. The coined/math terms below are handled per-locale (native term / transliteration / capitalization) and are NOT hard-enforced — they were reviewed against real native-speaker developer usage.
register: Precise, technical, developer-facing — not marketing-flowery. Use the formal/informal 'you' that is conventional for developer documentation in the target language (e.g. de: du; ja: です・ます; ko: 합니다체; pt-BR: você; ru: вы). Keep UI labels and button text concise. Use locale number formatting where natural (e.g. de/pt decimal comma: 0,6).

terms.lisse: Brand and npm scope (@lisse/*). NEVER translate or transliterate. Lowercase 'lisse' is the wordmark; 'Lisse' capitalized in running prose. Keep verbatim (enforced).
terms.squircle: Keep the Latin word in zh / ja / ko / pt-BR. In German, capitalize it as a noun (Squircle, Figma-Squircle). In Russian, transliterate and decline it in prose (сквиркл), keeping the Latin form only where it is the literal CSS `squircle` keyword. ja/ko may gloss once on first use (スクワークル / 스쿼클).
terms.superellipse: Use the established native mathematical term: zh 超椭圆, ja スーパー楕円, ko 초타원, pt-BR superelipse, ru суперэллипс, de Superellipse (capitalized German noun). Optionally gloss the English once in parentheses on first use.
terms.clothoid: Use the native term: zh 回旋曲线, ja クロソイド(曲線), ko 클로소이드, pt-BR clotoide, ru Клотоида, de Klothoide.
terms.Euler / Bézier: Latin (with accents) in Latin-script locales (de, pt). Native script in Russian (Эйлер, Безье). zh/ja/ko: hybrid is fine (e.g. 欧拉 / オイラー), gloss once at most.
terms.border-radius / corner-shape: CSS property names — code. Keep verbatim in every locale (enforced).
terms.Figma / Sketch / Apple / iOS / Chrome /: Product, company and org names. Keep verbatim (enforced).
terms.React / Vue / Svelte / SVG / CSS / npm: Framework names, acronyms, tooling. Keep verbatim (enforced).
terms.playground / binding / feature flag / de: Loanwords — keep the form real developers use in the target language (most keep these in English; ru prefers Песочница for playground and avoids the literal 'флаг функции').
terms.un galet lisse / cheveux lisses / une co: French phrases in the dictionary-style header definition. Keep the French verbatim (they illustrate the word's French origin).

rules: Translate the VALUE only, never the key.
Preserve every {placeholder} token exactly (same names, same count).
Never alter text inside backticks `like this`, install commands, or math formulas/symbols (e.g. |x/R|^n + |y/R|^n = 1, n = 5, 1/R, κ).
Preserve sentence-joining spacing exactly as in the English value (some messages are fragments joined with spaces in the UI).
Read naturally to a native-speaker developer — avoid calques and over-literal phrasing.
